widget_values_sig:
"[solo]

[verse]
Makin' lyrics, they're so fun
I didn't think about these a ton
I wrote these lyrics when I was high
before I sellout I'd rather die

[chorus]
It's best to put these lyrics
into sections of four.
Or else you'll be in hysterics
and wondering if there's more

[verse]
So you see, my lyrics are awful
but if you sing 'em it's not unlawful
because it's all open source,
you can copy them without remorse!

[chorus]
It's best to put these lyrics
into sections of four.
Or else you'll be in hysterics
and wondering if there's more

[verse]
So take these lyrics, and test away
hope your song comes out okay
If it doesn't, I'm not at fault
Launch you out of a catapult

[chorus]
It's best to put these lyrics
into sections of four.
Or else you'll be in hysterics
and wondering if there's more

[outro]
I hope the song came out fine.
We'll make another one one more time
Don't worry, next one will be great
And if not, it's probably too late"
'honkytonk, blues, r&b, acoustic guitar, drums, 140 bpm, energetic, uplifting, male vocals'
